insight: Built by Quora, whose CEO Adam D'Angelo also sits on OpenAI's board — one of the four who voted to remove Sam Altman in 2023.
name: Poe
tagline: One app for many AI models — chat and build bots across providers.
description: Quora's aggregator that puts models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, Meta, and others behind a single subscription, alongside image and video bots. Anyone can build a custom no-code bot in minutes, and creators are paid based on usage. Available on web, mobile, and desktop, with an API for developers.

modelSupport.notes: One points-based subscription spans many providers plus image/video models.

edge: One Quora-built subscription spanning many providers' chat, image, and video models, plus no-code bots that pay creators on usage.
cons: Less depth than each model's native app
